voiceSummary: Techno Electric and Engineering Company Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 12 November 2026. The Board approved and took on record the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The statutory auditors, M/s. Walker Chandiok and Co. LLP, issued a review report dated 12 November 2026. The report noted trade receivables aggregating to 896.35 million pending settlement as of 30 September 2026. Management considers these balances fully recoverable. The auditor did not review interim financial information for eleven subsidiaries reflecting total assets of 15,791.86 million. Three other subsidiaries with total assets of 2,352.63 million were not reviewed by their auditors. The Board also approved the standalone financial results for the same period.

attchmntText: Techno Electric & Engineering Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Techno Electric and Engineering Company Limited has intimated the National Stock Exchange of India and BSE Limited regarding an analyst and investors conference call. The call is scheduled for November 13, 2026, at 3:30 PM IST. It will discuss the un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Company representatives Mr. P. P. Gupta, Chairman and Managing Director, and Mr. Ankit Saraiya, Director and CEO, will participate. Dial-in numbers for India, Hong Kong, and Singapore are provided. Registration is available via a Diamond Pass link. The intimation is submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
